headline: Information Security Officer
summary: Information security officer with ten years in banking IT, the last five leading security for a cooperative bank. I built its information security management system from scratch, write and enforce policy, run internal IT audits and lead incident response. I translate BSP circulars and the Data Privacy Act into practical controls and report risk plainly to the board.
highlights: Led the bank to ISO/IEC 27001 certification in 18 months with a team of two.
Wrote and rolled out the three-year information security strategy approved by the board in 2023.
Cut critical findings in the annual external IT audit from nine to one over three years.
Ran the response to a 2024 credential-phishing campaign; no accounts were compromised.
skills: ICT and data privacy legislation (RA 10173, BSP circulars)

experience.title: Information Security Officer
bullets: Report to the board risk committee on security posture, incidents and control gaps every quarter.
Built the ISMS, including the risk register, asset inventory, policies and the internal audit programme.
Run tabletop exercises with branch heads and third-party vendors twice a year.

experience.title: IT Security Analyst
bullets: Monitored alerts from the bank's security tools and led investigations of suspicious log-ins and malware.
Tested access controls and change management for the yearly IT audit.

experience.title: Systems and Network Administrator
bullets: Ran the office servers and network and introduced the company's first password and backup policies.
Replaced the unmanaged office switches and set up remote access for the port office.

education.school: Central Luzon Graduate School of Technology

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
